metadata.name: Geochemical Sediment Core Log LTp22-1 from Pacific Ocean (2022)
metadata.description: A geochemical sediment core dataset containing CLR-normalized elemental concentrations (Si, K, Ca, Ti, V, Cr, Mn, Fe, Ni, Cu, Zn, Ge, Sr, Zr, Cd, Ce, Ta) and scattering metrics from a single core (Event LTp22-1) collected on April 8, 2022. The data covers a depth range of 0.0 to 0.2 meters, representing a temporal span from approximately 1867 to 2022 CE, collected at a fixed point location (21.28°N, 104.69°W) at 1430m elevation.
